item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem:
Harish sees a tiny point of light moving steadily across the night sky, unlike the twinkling stars. His teacher says it may be an artificial satellite — a human-made object that orbits Earth. Artificial satellites can be used for mapping or communication, and old satellites and rocket parts can become space debris. The Moon is Earth's natural satellite.

Which statement is correct?

options.A: Artificial satellites are natural objects that orbit Earth, just like the Moon.
options.B: Artificial satellites are human-made, can support mapping or communication, and old ones can become space debris.
options.C: Artificial satellites can never be seen in the night sky.
options.D: Artificial satellites make their own light, just as stars do.
